title: CALMA Agency
category: Brand identity • Brand guidelines • Company profile • Social media design
description: A brand system for CALMA Agency, connecting its wordmark and monogram with guidelines, a company profile and social content. The presentation uses blue, white and black across editorial and campaign layouts.
challenge: Connect an agency identity with its profile and an ongoing series of campaign messages.
solution: The CALMA monogram becomes a repeating pattern and a visual anchor. A clear type system and alternating blue-and-white layouts link the profile to social content.
results: A supplied identity presentation, company-profile design and selected social applications. Business-growth claims inside campaign artwork are advertising copy, not measured project outcomes.
